outcome.reason: real-run spec deviates from or is missing Manager-locked params (p, D, m, margin); no silent fallback. Set `_fixture_mode: true` on the spec to exclude from real-run admissibility and run as a fixture.

judgment_flagged: R6cat ambiguity adjudication (e.g., near-miss / typo'd C*)
forbidden_interpretations: certified baseline (the evaluator emits CERTIFY only when the run+gate clear it; it is not a certification of-record)
model passed / capability established / not shortcut-driven
depth-2 heuristic approximates traversal (E6 binding forbidden justification)

policy_notes.m_floor: m < 5 not allowed; m > 10 acceptable (log actual; floor unchanged unless m < 5)
policy_notes.authority: TL ACTION 2026-06-15 + Manager approval + value-lock patch ACTION
policy_notes.fixture_mode: spec.`_fixture_mode: true` excludes a construction from real-run admissibility; allows param variation for testing
